dataIssueDetail: No fixable data issue affecting the PTC oracle. The fixture line 0QLWC000003kjtG4AQ is a VALID TermDefined line: SellingModelType=TermDefined, SubscriptionTerm=1, PeriodBoundary=Anniversary, StartDate=2026-06-29, EndDate=2027-06-29, Qty=5, USD, ListPrice=5900, parent Quote 0Q0WC000003FaO20AK USD/Draft. The PBE is healthy (01uWC000005wry2YAA: IsActive=true, UnitPrice=5900, USD, Fortra Price Book IsActive=true, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType=TermDefined). The line's UnitPrice/NetUnitPrice=0 and Source_List_Price__c=null are the known headless Apex-insert hydration artifact (list never flowed to NetUnitPrice on the place/reprice path) and are NOT the PTC oracle — PricingTermCount is term-derived, not price-derived. Critically, the null-PTC reproduces on REAL properly-priced lines org-wide (see liveNumbers), so it is not a fixture artifact.

reason: AFFIRMATIVELY PROVEN on all three required axes. (1) INPUT VALID: the cited QLI matches test_setup (valid TermDefined line, SubscriptionTerm=1, PeriodBoundary=Anniversary, USD, healthy active $5900 PBE, EndDate populated); the only anomaly (UnitPrice=0) is the documented headless-insert price artifact and is independent of the PTC oracle. (2) INTENDED BRANCH ABSENT (the gating proof): independent inspection of the LIVE-active V21 metadata confirms there is NO TermDefined-gated proration/PTC writer anywhere - the sole Proration->PricingTermCount writer is gated SellingModelType='Evergreen' (ListOperation83), and every TermDefined reference in V21 is exclusionary or non-PTC. The branch that would set PTC for a TermDefined line cannot fire because it does not exist. Per METHOD_BRIEF taxonomy that is exactly PROCEDURE-DEFECT (inputs correct, intended branch absent -> wrong value), not TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT. (3) REPRODUCES ON FRESH REPRICE of the CURRENT active V21: Force-reprice isSuccess=true -> PTC=null, and the same null reproduces on 7+ REAL, properly-priced TermDefined lines org-wide (non-zero net, multiple PeriodBoundary values), decisively ruling out the headless-fixture hypothesis for the PTC oracle. uiUserWouldHit=yes: a real rep building a TermDefined quote in the UI hits the identical null PTC (the real org lines confirm it). I considered and rejected EXPECTATION-ERROR: although SC-3415's parent-verification accepted the quote-tier residual via an order-tier backstop (Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Dates V6, active 301WC00000knsJNYAY) and called it 'cosmetic', that is a documented MASKING workaround, not evidence the scenario's quote-tier expected_behavior is wrong; the defect genuinely reproduces on valid input with the intended branch structurally absent. CONCLUSION: agrees with the executor's FAIL/PROCEDURE-DEFECT. CORRECTION to the executor's regression narrative: the 'present in V16, lost in V16->V21 churn' framing is imprecise - the V16 PRISTINE backup (Data/sc3473/backup/V160_PRISTINE) and the live_v16 org retrieve BOTH have only the single Evergreen-gated Proration writer and NO TermDefined writer; only the un-shipped build/ staging artifact (the proposed SC-3420/SC-3473 guarded writer: parent TermDefinedProrationFilterLinelevel) contains it. So the writer was staged but never actually active in V16 either. This does not change the defect - active V21 genuinely lacks the TermDefined PTC writer and produces null PTC on valid TermDefined lines - but the regression should be cited as 'SC-3420 proration writer never shipped to active line; guarded fix built+E2E-passed but not deployed to V21', not 'regressed out of V16'.
